content: Do I need to lift heavy to build muscle?

Not necessarily. Research shows you can build similar muscle with lighter loads (roughly 30-85% of your 1RM) as long as your sets get close to failure, within about 0-3 reps of it. Heavier work in the 5-10 rep range is more time-efficient and builds strength faster, and your goal of a 100 kg bench needs that strength. The best plan is mostly moderate reps (6-12) with some heavy sets and some lighter, higher-rep accessory work. 💪
